authority: Centralized canvas tool rail, compact opaque layer pane, thumbnail asset browsers, popup color controls, and in-app help
rules: The canvas never defaults to a modifying tool merely because a resource or layer is selected
The left tool rail is the canonical tool selector for canvas operations
Top workspace bars may contain view, transport, document, or mode commands but may not duplicate canvas tool selection
Unavailable tools remain visible for spatial consistency but are grey and non-clickable
Layer chrome shows only visibility, layer title, and lock state
Asset browsers prefer thumbnails and bounded lazy loading over text-only lists
Color controls may pop out without permanently shrinking the authoring canvas
Help and active key bindings are discoverable inside the application
